Industry · Electricians

Websites for electricians that win more work.

Nifty Websites Australia builds websites for electricians that are designed to rank in local search and turn visitors into booked jobs. Each site is mobile-first, loads fast, shows your services and service areas, makes it easy to request a quote, and includes a complete SEO build so customers find you first.

Get a Free Quote See how it works
$2,000SEO build included
on every website, free.
The challenge

Why most electrician websites quietly lose jobs.

Homeowners and builders search on their phone and call the first electrician who looks trustworthy and answers fast. A slow or dated site loses that job before you ever hear about it.

  • They cannot find you locallyIf you do not rank for electrician searches in your area, the job goes to whoever does.
  • The site is slow on a phoneMost enquiries come from a mobile. A heavy, slow page loses them in seconds.
  • No easy way to get a quoteIf it takes more than a tap to call or request a quote, people move on.
  • Nothing builds trustNo reviews, licence details or real photos, and a homeowner will not risk the booking.
Built for the trade

What an electrician's website actually needs.

Click to call and quote

One tap to call you or request a quote, on every screen, so a hot lead never goes cold.

Service areas that rank

Your suburbs and service areas set out so you show up for local electrician searches.

Licence and trust signals

Your licence, insurance, guarantees and real reviews, front and centre where they reassure buyers.

A gallery of real work

Before-and-after photos of switchboards, fit-outs and jobs done, so your work sells itself.

Fast on mobile

A lightweight build that loads instantly on a phone, where your customers actually are.

Emergency and after-hours

Make it obvious you take urgent call-outs, so the 9pm no-power search calls you.

How it works

From brief to booked jobs, a clear process.

The brief

We learn your services, your service areas and the jobs you want more of.

Concept for approval

We design a concept around trust and quick quotes, and you approve it before we build on.

Build and free SEO

We build fast, add your local SEO build, and load your services, areas and reviews.

Go live

We launch, connect your tracking, and hand over a site set up to bring in electrical work.

Pricing

What affects the cost of an electrician's website.

Every job is quoted on scope. These are the main things that move the price up or down. For full pricing, see our pricing page.

  • Number of pages and servicesA single service area page costs less than a full site covering every service and suburb.
  • Content and photosWhether you supply your job photos and details, or we write and arrange them.
  • Extra featuresOnline booking, live chat or area-by-area landing pages add build time.

Common questions

Electrician website questions, answered.

How much does a website for an electrician cost?

It depends on how many services and areas you want to cover. We give you a fixed, itemised quote after a short chat, and every site includes a complete SEO build. See our pricing page for guidance.

Will my website help me get found in my area?

Yes. Every build includes local SEO covering your suburbs and service areas, so you are set up to rank for electrician searches near you and be found by nearby customers.

Can customers request a quote or call me from the site?

Yes. Click to call and a simple quote form sit on every page, so a homeowner or builder can reach you in one tap from their phone.

Do you build websites for electricians across Australia?

Yes. We are an Australian team and build for electricians Australia-wide, with local pages for cities and regional areas across the country.
